svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 950 commits across five public projects, 67 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-28 through 2026-11-19 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-19T04:29:25.933Z.
